title: Skincare for Bike Riders: Sun, Dust and Helmet Care for Daily Commuters
ex: A daily two-wheeler ride means sun, dust and helmet sweat. A 3-minute routine before you ride, helmet hygiene, and how to wash and moisturise after.
rt: Skincare for Bike Riders: Sun, Dust and Helmet | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare for bike riders in India: sunscreen before you ride, a face cover against dust, helmet hygiene for fewer pimples, and an after-ride wash routine.
quick: Put on sunscreen (SPF 30 or more) a few minutes before you ride, cover your face, neck and hands against sun and dust, keep your helmet liner clean, and wash and moisturise gently as soon as you reach. Use your night cream after washing off sunscreen at night.
facts: Sunscreen on face, neck, ears and hands
A washable cotton cloth under the helmet
Wash once gently after the ride
Rain and clouds do not block UV
